## The question

What decision does this settle? Why does it need settling before work becomes `ready-for-agent`?

## What it unblocks

Which issues/tracks are waiting on this.

## Output

What closing this ticket should produce - normally a short recommendation written up as an ADR
in `docs/adr/`.
